title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
abstract: arXiv:2610.41398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. translated_title: 从搜索中蒸馏知识：面向量子LDPC码的解码器模型工厂
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GraphMP，一种基于学习的量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码消息传递解码器，它无需微调即可在不同码族、码尺寸、物理错误率和噪声模型之间迁移。GraphMP使用局部消息传递，使计算在解码图规模增长时保持可扩展性。在其预测的引导下，束搜索逐步细化候选错误模式，以额外的解码时间换取更低的逻辑错误率。我们开发了“解码器模型工厂”这一范式，利用早期模型在解码过程中产生的经验来训练后续模型。模型引导的搜索为知识蒸馏提供了经过验证的轨迹，将在解码上消耗的计算折叠为可复用的训练数据。反复的收集与蒸馏使解码器在各代之间不断改进，并随噪声变化自适应地调整策略。这些结果激发了一种耦合的量子-经典架构，其中两个相互……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出GraphMP解码器与“解码器模型工厂”范式，将模型引导搜索的解码计算转化为可复用训练数据进行知识蒸馏，实现无需微调即可跨码族与噪声模型迁移、并随各代训练持续自我改进的量子LDPC码解码器。
en_tdlr: Proposes GraphMP, a transferable message-passing decoder for quantum LDPC codes, together with a "decoder model factory" paradigm that folds model-guided search computation into reusable training data via knowledge distillation, enabling continuous cross-generation self-improvement without fine-tuning.
